title: Reducibility of symmetry on $q$-Painlevé equations
summary: It is known that $q$-Painlevé equations admit the symmetry of the extended affine Weyl groups. Kajiwara, Noumi and Yamada developed a unified description of the symmetry by introducing representations of the extended affine Weyl groups. On the other hand, a parallel translation associated with the extended affine Weyl groups describes the time evolution in Sakai's theory of discrete Painlevé equations.
